|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Gardulla The Hutt (V)]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Gardulla The Hutt (V)]] (original, release sheet of 16 December 2011); [[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “During battle, if [Virtual Block 4] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to a site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF dated 19 December 2011, the same file the Players Committee site offered in February 2012), page 2, slip 1 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 8). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=8, page 8. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “to any site you occupy” for “to a site you occupy”, “force” and “interrupt” in lower case, and no comma after “Once per game” (it writes the icons as “[Virtual]” and “[Immune To Sense]”, which is notation only): “During battle, if [Virtual] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 force to cancel a non-[Immune To Sense] interrupt. Once per game during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to any site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.”<ref name="cl-1274_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-gardullathehutt-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V)]]) again, word for word: “During battle, if [Virtual Block 4] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to a site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 8)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V)]]) again, word for word: “During battle, if [Virtual Block 4] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to a site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-1-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
